snippet.title: Mayak - Game & New Art Style Reveal Trailer - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3910330/Mayak/
